parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no populated `members` array, no `structural_evidence` fields (all null), and no `differing_slots`, `jaccard`, or `shared_field_count` values. Without any grounded field-level or signature-level evidence from the participating records `PauseWXYC` and `ToggleWXYC` in `Shared/Intents/Sources/Intents/`, it is impossible to determine whether the structural similarity is meaningful or merely coincidental. Recommending an action such as protocol-inheritance or extract-to-common would require inventing evidence not present in the cluster row, which is prohibited.
